title: YELLOW FEVER : DESIGNATED VACCINATING CENTRES = FIÈVRE JAUNE : CENTRES DE VACCINATION HABILITÉS

sections.title: FIÈVRE JAUNE

summary.text: A French heading amending the 1953 supplement listing designated yellow fever vaccinating centres, introducing an insertion for Bechuanaland.

sections.extract: CENTRES DE VACCINATION HABILITÉS Amendement au Supplément du 19S3/Supp./N° 2. BECHOUANALAND A la page 3, insérer :

sections.title: YELLOW FEVER

summary.text: An English amendment to the 1953 list of designated yellow fever vaccinating centres, adding the Government Medical Officer at Mahalapye in Bechuanaland.

sections.extract: DESIGNATED VACCINATING CENTRES Amendment to the Supplement to R.E.H.: 1953/Supp./No. 2. BECHUANALAND On page 3, insert ; Mahalapye: The Government Medical Officer.
